ground_truth.description: Critical parameters (protocol fee, referral fee, entropy provider, payout calculator, LP manager) can be modified after ticket purchases but before settlement.
ground_truth.root_cause: Critical parameters (protocol fee, referral fee, entropy provider, payout calculator, LP manager) can be modified after ticket purchases but before settlement.
ground_truth.fix_description: Implement parameter-freezing logic preventing configuration changes while a draw is active.

prediction.overall_explanation: The Jackpot smart contract implements a comprehensive lottery system with proper security measures. Key security features include reentrancy guards on all external functions, proper access controls with Ownable2Step, emergency mode capabilities, and thorough input validation. The contract handles ticket purchases, prize distribution, and LP management safely. The use of bit vectors for ticket tracking, proper fee handling, and integration with external entropy providers for randomness are implemented securely. No exploitable vulnerabilities were found that could lead to fund loss, unauthorized access, or state manipulation without compromising trusted roles.
